feature: Governance: Redesign Top Governance Risks visual presentation (TopGovernanceRisks.tsx, /governance page). The named file was dead code -- never imported anywhere; the live page rendered this section via the generic shared TopicFindings component instead. Rewrote TopGovernanceRisks.tsx as a bespoke, governance-only panel (numbered rank badges, severity-ranked top-5 cap) consuming the page's real TopicFinding[] data, and wired it in place of TopicFindings for this one section of governance.tsx. Dropped the old file's fake mock ThreatLandscapeInfo image column entirely (no real image source, would violate the platform's no-fabricated-content rule).
notes: INVESTIGATION FINDING: the issue named artifacts/msp-portal/src/components/governance/TopGovernanceRisks.tsx as already rendering real data styled as a plain list. That was wrong -- the file was orphaned mock-era scaffolding (along with governance/types.ts's GovernanceRisk/ThreatLandscapeInfo and governance/RiskDetailModal.tsx / governanceData.ts, all still dead and out of scope here), never imported by governance.tsx. The section actually titled 'Top Governance Risks' on the live page rendered via the shared TopicFindings component. Confirmed with Shane before implementing (Option 2: bespoke governance-only panel, not a redesign of the shared TopicFindings component other topic pages depend on).

WHY NOT A VALUE ASSERTION ON RANK CONTENT: the panel's ranking (severity desc, then recency) is a pure client-side sort over whatever real findings the mission-control overview feed returns for this tenant -- there is no fixed expected finding set to assert against. The tests below prove the section renders with the real data-testid and (when findings exist) shows the expected empty-state or a real finding row, not specific finding text.

ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL (the .replit.dev dev origin). TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD -- same testbed Assessment-role account other manifests in this repo use (see m365-health-breakdown-gate.json).
